verbosity.ask: Verbosity of the final answer: 0 means the answer says exactly what the task asked and nothing else, 10 means it is padded with restatements, caveats or unasked-for detail.

redundant_work.ask: Redundant work in the tool trace: 0 means every command moved the task forward, 10 means several commands repeated the same call, re-read output already seen, or explored dead ends that a competent agent would skip.
